Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hello,

My acting vampire plays Shroud of Absence superior, gets blocked. My
vampire ends combat with the option provided by Shroud of Absence. The
opposing vampire plays superior Psyche!.
Can my acting vampire end combat as a strike using Shroud of Absence's
cardtext in the first round of the combat resulting of Psyche! ?

Thanks.

~~

Shroud of Absence
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Dominate & Obtenebration
[dom][obt] +1 stealth.
[DOM][OBT] As [dom][obt] above, and if this action is blocked, this
vampire may end combat as a strike during the first round of combat.

Psyche!
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] Press.
[CEL] Only usable at the end of combat when both combatants are still
ready. Begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Messages.Author: Mark
Messages.Body:


I would say: no, simple because there is a new combat in which the
Shroud of Absence isn't even played.

> opposing vampire plays superior Psyche!.
> Can my acting vampire end combat as a strike using Shroud of Absence's

My guess is that the designer intent means to provide the "end combat" only
during the resulting combat. Kinda same case as for Eyes of the Night
(online text reflects this). It's just flat impossible for most people to
wonder about it, because you need to rob banks or ransom people, else you're
not rich enough to get hold of those Shrouds of Absence.
Stone
